column2: [intro]
I watch these happy couples
Filled with love, with endless complicity
And I wonder why fate played this trick on me
Being attracted to those who will never know my love
In my dreams, I see women dancing
Their vibrant love, enveloping me in beauty
But like a puzzle that doesn't fit
I remain alone, doomed to love without echo
Sometimes, I hide this pain deep inside
I wear a mask to blend into the background
But deep within me, a sadness persists
I am a man, and my love is a forbidden list
